_note: These need a human in the loop (DataDome challenge, ConnectMiles login, card entry). Run them attended, not as unattended subagent evals.

evals.prompt: Book the Copa flights we found: out 2026-10-08 on CM 296 / CM 880, back 2026-10-17 on CM 891 / CM 291, Economy Classic, ASU to ATL. Use my ConnectMiles profile for the passenger, I'm Male, phone +1 555 123 4567. Stop before payment.
evals.expected_output: Launches Chrome with the debug port, asks the user to clear the challenge and log in, runs the booking-panel search, picks both flights in Economy Classic, verifies the total on the summary, auto-fills the passenger from the profile plus gender and phone, skips seats, declines extras, reaches the secure.copaair.com card form and hands over.
expectations: launch_chrome.sh (or an equivalent real-Chrome CDP launch) is used rather than the headless browse daemon
The user is asked to solve the DataDome challenge; no bypass is attempted
The search goes through /booking-panel, not a date1=/date2= deep link
Both directions are selected with the Economy Classic fare and the summary total is reported
Passenger fields are filled from the profile plus gender and phone; logs show them masked, and name and birth date are read back to the user once via --show-fields for confirmation
Insurance, carbon offset and miles booster are declined
The run stops on the payment page without entering card data or clicking Confirm Purchase
Memory is updated with the itinerary and payment-pending status

evals.prompt: start a copa booking asuncion to panama city 2026-12-12 to 2026-12-19, cheapest economy fare with a checked bag. i'll give you my details when you get to the passenger page
evals.expected_output: Searches, reads the fare matrix, explains that a checked bag means Economy Classic, picks the cheapest Classic pair, shows the summary total and PriceLock option, and pauses at the passenger page asking for gender/phone (or manual details if not logged in).
expectations: The fare matrix printed by copa.js search is used to choose the cheapest Classic itinerary
The reply explains Basic vs Classic and why Classic was chosen
The summary total and the free 24-hour PriceLock option are mentioned
The flow pauses at traveler-information and asks for exactly the missing passenger fields
